publish.corpusSummary: 300,000 sentences of German news (2024) and 300,000 of German web text (2021) from the Leipzig Corpora Collection
publish.registerCaveat: These corpora are news and web text, so the list over-weights politics, sport and economics and under-weights conversation. For spoken or everyday German, weight it against a spoken corpus.

out/lemmas.tsv.description: 15,471 inflected surface forms mapped to their lemma.
out/lemmas.tsv.publishNote: ⚠️ NOT bundled with frequency.txt. Share-alike would contaminate the CC BY list, and a frequency list nobody can use permissively is not the public good this repo is for. Ship it separately or not at all.

sources.name: Leipzig Corpora Collection — deu_news_2024_300K
sources.note: The downloaded archive ships NO licence file; the CC BY claim comes from the project's web pages. Four routes were tried on 2026-07-30 — /en/usage, /en/download/, repo.data.saw-leipzig.de and the CLARIN VLO — and /en/usage answers with an interstitial reading 'Making sure you're not a bot!'. So the terms remain UNREAD, which is what keeps this false. An earlier note in the sibling repo claimed CC BY-NC and was wrong. ⚠️ Also unresolved: the version. This file says 3.0; the corpora project publishes word lists as CC BY 3.0 but its RDF datasets as CC BY 4.0, and secondary summaries cite 4.0 for the downloadable corpora. Settle the version in the same reading.

sources.name: Universal Dependencies — German-GSD treebank
sources.note: Verified by reading the treebank's own LICENSE.txt at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_German-GSD/master/LICENSE.txt on 2026-07-30. It reads, in full: 'The treebank is licensed under the Creative Commons License Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International.' No non-commercial clause, no text-use restriction.

sources.name: Universal Dependencies — German-HDT treebank
sources.note: Verified by reading LICENSE.txt at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_German-HDT/master/LICENSE.txt on 2026-07-30: 'The annotation of the treebank is licensed under the Creative Commons License Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International. The text can be distributed for academic use.' ⚠️ That second sentence is the constraint. The ANNOTATION is CC BY-SA 4.0; the underlying TEXT is academic-use only. Only the FORM and LEMMA columns are read and no source text is redistributed, which is what keeps this usable — do not widen the extraction without re-reading the terms.
